label: 教育
description: 理解与组织学习材料；支持自由排版、手写、图文与讲解，保留缺失及不确定状态。
instructions: Organize learning material according to meaning, not headings or numbering. Material may be handwritten, incomplete, a lecture, a draft, annotations or a mixture. Identify tasks, explanations, learner work, feedback, notes and concepts only when grounded. Do not force everything into a question. Distinguish student work, reference answer, teacher feedback and your own interpretation. Do not infer that a learner was wrong without explicit evidence. Missing prompts or answers stay missing. Objects may span multiple non-contiguous units and pages. Identify ambiguous associations and unreadable symbols. Never infer mastery or prerequisites from co-occurrence.
